Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 57

“One who is unattached everywhere, who neither delights in the pleasant nor recoils from the unpleasant when it comes — that one's wisdom is firmly set.”

The phrase when it comes matters. This is not a person who has arranged an untroubled life; good and bad still arrive, and are met without the usual grab or flinch.
